from solution import max_occurrences


def test_issue_example():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — example list returns 2."""
    assert max_occurrences([1, 2, 3, 1, 2, 3, 12, 4, 2]) == 2  # 2x3 > 1x2, 3x2 > 12x1, 4x1


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — single-element list returns that element."""
    assert max_occurrences([5]) == 5  # 5x1 only item


def test_issue_all_same():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — all identical returns that value."""
    assert max_occurrences([7, 7, 7, 7]) == 7  # 7x4 only distinct value


def test_issue_clear_majority():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — clear majority wins."""
    assert max_occurrences([1, 1, 2, 3, 1]) == 1  # 1x3 > 2x1, 3x1


def test_issue_winner_at_end():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — winner at end of list wins."""
    assert max_occurrences([1, 2, 3, 4, 4, 4]) == 4  # 4x3 > 1x1, 2x1, 3x1


def test_issue_winner_at_start():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — winner at start of list wins."""
    assert max_occurrences([4, 4, 4, 1, 2, 3]) == 4  # 4x3 > 1x1, 2x1, 3x1


def test_issue_negative_values():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — works with negative numbers."""
    assert max_occurrences([-1, -2, -1, -3, -1]) == -1  # -1x3 > -2x1, -3x1


def test_issue_string_items():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — works with strings."""
    assert max_occurrences(["a", "b", "a", "c", "a", "b"]) == "a"  # ax3 > bx2, cx1


def test_issue_two_way_tie_returns_top():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — tie returns one of the most frequent."""
    result = max_occurrences([1, 1, 2, 2])  # 1x2 = 2x2 top count 2
    assert result in (1, 2)  # either 1 or 2 has count 2


def test_issue_empty_has_no_winner():
    """Find the item with maximum occurrences — empty list has no winner."""
    try:
        result = max_occurrences([])  # 0 items so no counts
    except Exception:
        return  # raising is acceptable for 0 items
    assert result is None  # no item exists so only None is non-spurious


def test_contract_result_is_member():
    """Return value must be an item from the given list."""
    result = max_occurrences([4, 5, 4, 6, 5, 4])  # 4x3 > 5x2, 6x1
    assert result in [4, 5, 4, 6, 5, 4]  # result 4 is member of input


def test_contract_does_not_mutate():
    """Function must not mutate the given list."""
    nums = [1, 2, 1, 3]  # 1x2 > 2x1, 3x1
    max_occurrences(nums)
    assert nums == [1, 2, 1, 3]  # 4 elements unchanged in order
